017package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.auth.oidc.rp;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
020
021import java.time.*;
022import java.util.*;
023
024/**
025 * The shipped, single-node default {@link LoginStateStore}: a single-use, TTL-bounded, size-bounded
026 * in-memory store for the per-login {@code state} &rarr; {@link LoginStateStore.PendingLogin} association
027 * created during {@link OidcRelyingParty#startLogin} and consumed during {@link OidcRelyingParty#completeLogin}.
028 *
029 * <p>
030 * Security properties (see OpenID Connect Core &sect;3.1.2.1 and the RP charter):
031 * <ul>
032 *    <li><b>Single-use</b> &mdash; {@link #consume(String)} atomically removes the entry under a monitor, so a
033 *       replayed callback with the same {@code state} fails.  Cross-node single-use requires a shared store
034 *       with an atomic consume primitive (see {@link LoginStateStore#consume(String)}); this impl only
035 *       guarantees single-use within one JVM.
036 *    <li><b>TTL-bounded</b> &mdash; entries at or past their framework-minted {@code expiresAt} are treated as a
037 *       miss and swept.
038 *    <li><b>Size-bounded</b> &mdash; an LRU cap (default 10 000) prevents unbounded growth from abandoned
039 *       login attempts; eviction mirrors the {@code BoundedLruTokenCache} shape.
040 * </ul>
041 *
042 * <p>
043 * The framework mints {@code createdAt}/{@code expiresAt} on the {@link LoginStateStore.PendingLogin} record;
044 * this impl persists them verbatim and does not stamp timestamps of its own.  The {@code ttl} argument here
045 * only bounds sweep/GC of abandoned entries and asserts the framework's {@code (0, MAX_TTL]} ceiling for the
046 * default path; the relying party re-checks {@code expiresAt} independently on consume.
047 *
048 * <p>
049 * Thread-safe.
050 *
051 * @since 10.0.0
052 */
053public class InMemoryLoginStateStore implements LoginStateStore {
054
055   /** Default maximum number of in-flight login attempts retained. */
056   public static final int DEFAULT_MAX_ENTRIES = 10_000;
057
058   /** Default time-to-live for a pending login (the user has at most a few minutes at the IdP). */
059   public static final Duration DEFAULT_TTL = Duration.ofMinutes(5);
060
061   private final int maxEntries;
062   private final Clock clock;
063   private final Map<String,PendingLogin> entries;
064   private final Object lock = new Object();
065
066   /**
067    * Constructor.
068    *
069    * @param ttl The single-use TTL.  Must be positive and not exceed {@link LoginStateStore#MAX_TTL}.  Bounds
070    *    sweep of abandoned entries and asserts the framework ceiling for the default path; per-entry expiry is
071    *    driven by the framework-minted {@link LoginStateStore.PendingLogin#expiresAt()}.
072    * @param maxEntries The LRU size cap.  Must be positive.
073    * @param clock The clock for TTL sweeping.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
074    */
075   public InMemoryLoginStateStore(Duration ttl, int maxEntries, Clock clock) {
076      reqnn("ttl", ttl);
077      req(!ttl.isZero() && !ttl.isNegative(), "ttl must be positive");
078      req(ttl.compareTo(MAX_TTL) <= 0, "ttl must not exceed 30 minutes (was %s)", ttl);
079      req(maxEntries > 0, "maxEntries must be positive (was %s)", maxEntries);
080      this.maxEntries = maxEntries;
081      this.clock = reqnn("clock", clock);
082      this.entries = new LinkedHashMap<>(16, 0.75f, true) {
083         private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
084         @Override
085         protected boolean removeEldestEntry(Map.Entry<String,PendingLogin> eldest) {
086            return size() > InMemoryLoginStateStore.this.maxEntries;
087         }
088      };
089   }
090
091   @Override /* LoginStateStore */
092   public void store(String state, PendingLogin pending) {
093      reqnb("state", state);
094      reqnn("pending", pending);
095      var now = clock.instant();
096      synchronized (lock) {
097         sweepExpired(now);
098         entries.put(state, pending);
099      }
100   }
101
102   @Override /* LoginStateStore */
103   public Optional<PendingLogin> consume(String state) {
104      if (state == null)
105         return oe();
106      var now = clock.instant();
107      synchronized (lock) {
108         var p = entries.remove(state);
109         if (p == null)
110            return oe();
111         if (isExpired(p, now))
112            return oe();
113         return o(p);
114      }
115   }
116
117   /**
118    * Returns the current entry count.  Primarily for tests and metrics.
119    *
120    * @return The entry count.
121    */
122   public int size() {
123      synchronized (lock) {
124         return entries.size();
125      }
126   }
127
128   private boolean isExpired(PendingLogin p, Instant now) {
129      var exp = p.expiresAt();
130      if (exp == null)
131         return true;
132      return !now.isBefore(exp);
133   }
134
135   private void sweepExpired(Instant now) {
136      entries.values().removeIf(p -> isExpired(p, now));
137   }
138}
